# vaultwarden_user (List Resource)

Lists all users of the server, sorted by email, including invited and disabled ones.

Requires `admin_token` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find all users of the server, and generate import blocks with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "vaultwarden_user" "all" {
  provider = vaultwarden
}

# Only users whose email contains "@example.com", ignoring case
list "vaultwarden_user" "example_com" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    email_contains = "@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email_contains` (String) Only list the users whose email contains this text, ignoring case
